title: MilestoneGatedPayload
description: Phase 3 (PLAN.md 169, memory.md §12.3). Produced by Practice Core's project-mode state machine after a milestone's validators + rubric slice have run. The gate decision for one milestone.

score.description: milestone score contribution, present once scored

rubric_level.description: rubric slice level, present when the milestone gate involves a rubric

blocking.description: whether a GATED_FAIL here blocks the next milestone
